## Owner checklist

- [ ] This pull request was authored by the repository owner.
- [ ] The change is tied to an accepted specification or maintenance need.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private keys, or sensitive local files are included.

External pull requests are not accepted and will be closed without merging.
